policy: Applied migration files are immutable. Rollback requires the per-revision action below and a verified backup.

0001_backtest_child_run_indexes.action: Drop the two backtest child-run indexes.

0002_level3_source_certification.action: Restore a verified backup or apply a reviewed forward schema migration after archiving certification data.

0003_level3plus_governance.action: Archive governance evidence, then use a reviewed forward migration or restore.

0004_insights.action: Archive insight evidence and drop the added tables in reverse dependency order.

0005_ashare_tech_reports.action: Archive reports and object references, then drop the added tables.

0006_ashare_tech_watchlist.action: Archive watchlist snapshots, then drop the added tables.

0007_web_end_date_default.action: Restore the previous setting value from a verified pre-migration backup.

0008_strategy_admission.action: Archive admission evidence and drop the added tables in reverse dependency order.

0009_backtest_failure_metadata.action: Archive failure metadata and remove the added column with a forward migration.

0010_lean_paper_walkforward.action: Pause Paper and restore a verified pre-migration backup after archiving evidence.

0011_data_sync_and_research_lifecycle.action: Archive sync and research evidence, then restore or apply a reviewed forward migration.

0012_workflow_verification_and_data_gaps.action: Archive verification evidence and drop added tables in reverse dependency order.

0014_data_sync_throughput_and_policy.action: Restore a verified backup or apply a reviewed forward migration after archiving checkpoints.

0015_ingestion_validation_and_watermarks.action: Archive ingestion evidence and remove added tables and columns with a forward migration.

0016_data_sync_heartbeat.action: Stop recovery workers and remove data_sync_runs.heartbeat_at with a forward migration.

0018_experiment_batches.action: Cancel active batches, archive results, and drop added tables in reverse dependency order.

0019_source_and_object_integrity.action: Recertify through the governed workflow; do not reinstate revoked rows directly.

0020_quarantine_orphan_raw_archives.action: Resolve quarantined evidence through the governed reconciliation workflow.

0021_alert_delivery_tracking.action: Archive delivery evidence and drop alert_deliveries and its indexes.

0022_paper_order_pipeline_v2.action: Pause Paper and restore a verified pre-migration backup after archiving immutable events.

0023_walk_forward_validation_oos.action: Use the rollback procedure declared in the migration header after archiving certified evidence.

0024_paper_constraint_matching_reconcili.action: Use the rollback procedure declared in the migration header after archiving evidence.

0025_paper_daily_scheduler.action: Use the rollback procedure declared in the migration header after stopping scheduling.

0026_restricted_runner_jobs.action: Use the rollback procedure declared in the migration header after stopping delegated workers.

0027_provider_archive_reconciliation.action: Correct reconciliation evidence with a reviewed forward migration.

0028_futures_continuous_attribution.action: Archive attribution evidence and drop added tables in reverse dependency order.

0029_paper_accounts.action: Use the rollback procedure declared in the migration header after pausing account scheduling.

0030_level4_data_governance.action: Archive coverage evidence and drop the added watermark tables.

0031_paper_ledger_integrity.action: Drop uq_paper_account_ledger_sequence only after pausing Paper and checking duplicates.

0032_api_idempotency_keys.action: Stop accepting idempotency keys, wait for in-flight writes, and drop api_idempotency_keys.

0033_retire_legacy_paper_sessions.action: Restore a verified pre-migration backup if retired legacy Paper evidence is required.

0034_unify_research_workflow.action: Stop Research workloads and restore the verified pre-migration backup.

0035_unify_optimization_workflow.action: Stop optimization workloads and restore the verified pre-migration backup.

0036_ashare_tech_agents.action: Stop report and evaluation workers, archive Agent and prediction evidence, then drop the added tables and report columns in a reviewed forward migration.

0037_merge_structured_insights.action: Stop report workers and restore a verified pre-migration database backup if the permanently deleted generic Insight history or tables are required.

0038_ml_cross_sectional_research.action: Stop ML workers, archive model and feature manifests, then remove the added tables and financial audit columns with a reviewed forward migration.
